ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a full larder
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Stock enough food that nobody goes hungry when the fields stop growing.

plain.li: I've counted the stores. We won't last the lean months like this. Let's fill the larder: a month of food, minimum.
Hunger kills more colonies than raiders do. I say we plant, hunt and stockpile until the shelves groan.

warm.li: I want to know that whatever happens, nobody here goes to bed hungry. Let's build up our food stores together.

blunt.li: We're one bad harvest away from eating each other. Fill the larder. That's my proposal.

cheerful.li: Picture a storeroom so full we have to climb over the potatoes! Let's make it happen!

gloomy.li: The cold will come and the food will run out. Unless we start stockpiling now.

cold.li: Thirty days of reserves eliminates our largest single risk. It's the obvious priority.

plain.li: Look at those stores. Whatever comes, we'll eat.

cheerful.li: I may have climbed over the potatoes. Just once. It was glorious.

cold.li: Food security achieved. As planned.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a cold store
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a freezer and keep it stocked with meals, so nothing rots and nobody goes hungry.

plain.li: Every week I throw out food that turned. A freezer and a stack of meals in it would change everything.

warm.li: Imagine a cold room full of ready meals, so nobody waits hungry while I cook. Let's build it.

blunt.li: I'm sick of cooking for the flies. Freezer. Meals in it. Done.

cheerful.li: A freezer full of meals! I'll even label the shelves!

gloomy.li: Everything rots here. Food, hope, everything. Let's at least save the food.

cold.li: Spoilage is our single biggest waste. A stocked freezer fixes it.

plain.li: Shelves full, air cold, nothing rotting. Beautiful.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a real hospital
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a proper hospital with three medical beds and stock up on medicine before the next disaster.

plain.li: Last time someone was hurt, I patched them up on the floor next to the stove. We need a real hospital.
Three clean beds and a cabinet of medicine. That's what stands between a bad raid and a funeral.

warm.li: I never want to lose anyone because we weren't ready. Let's build a hospital we can be proud of.

blunt.li: You people keep getting shot. Build me a hospital so I can keep you alive.

cheerful.li: A real hospital! Clean beds! Medicine! I'm so excited I could stitch something!

gloomy.li: It's not if someone gets badly hurt. It's when. Let's be ready.

cold.li: Proper medical facilities cut mortality dramatically. This is not optional.

plain.li: Beds made, medicine shelved. Now, please, try not to need it.

blunt.li: Good. Now stop getting shot.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: rooms of our own
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Give every colonist a private bedroom. No more barracks.

plain.li: Everyone deserves a door they can close. I propose a private room for every one of us.
We fight better and work better after a good night's sleep. Private rooms for everyone.

warm.li: A room of your own makes a place feel like home. Let's make this colony a home.

blunt.li: I'm done with the barracks. You're done with the barracks. Let's build rooms.

cheerful.li: Rooms for everybody! With doors! And maybe little name signs!

gloomy.li: We can't even get a night's peace from each other. Let's fix that before someone snaps.

cold.li: Private rooms improve sleep quality and mood across the board. The math is simple.

plain.li: A room for everyone. This feels like a real settlement now.

cheerful.li: I made the name signs anyway!

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a great hall
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Turn the dining room into a hall worth gathering in: impressive, warm and full of good company.

plain.li: We eat three times a day. Let's do it somewhere grand: good floors, art on the walls, a hall to be proud of.

warm.li: The dining room is where we're a family. Let's make it beautiful.

blunt.li: Our dining room looks like a pirate's toilet. Let's build a proper hall.

cheerful.li: A great hall! Long tables! Feasts! Okay, maybe simple meals at first, but in a GREAT HALL!

gloomy.li: If we're going to die here, we might as well eat somewhere nice first.

cold.li: An impressive dining room gives a mood bonus three times a day. It's a high-return project.

plain.li: Look at this hall. Visitors are going to be jealous.

cheerful.li: First feast is on me! Well, on the cook. But I'll cheer the loudest!

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: fun and games
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a recreation room with at least five different kinds of recreation in the colony.

plain.li: All work and no play makes for mental breaks. I propose a proper rec room.

warm.li: We need somewhere to laugh together after a hard day. Let's build a rec room.

blunt.li: If I watch one more cloud I'm going to set something on fire. Rec room. Now.

cheerful.li: Games! Lots of games! A whole room of games! Who's with me?

gloomy.li: We need something to look forward to, or this place will eat us alive.

cold.li: Recreation variety prevents breakdowns. A rec room is cheap insurance.

plain.li: Game night is officially a colony tradition.

blunt.li: I'm going to win at everything. Fair warning.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: hold the line
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Strengthen the colony's defences until we can face the raids our wealth attracts. Add cover where the fighting happens.

plain.li: The raids are getting bigger and our defences aren't. Let's fix that before they fix us.
Cover, weapons, a place to make a stand. I propose we get ready for the next raid.

warm.li: I want everyone here to feel safe at night. Let's make this place a fortress.

blunt.li: Next time they come, I want them running back where they came from. Build defences.

cheerful.li: Let's make our home the last place any raider wants to visit!

gloomy.li: They'll come again. Bigger. Let's at least make them pay for it.

cold.li: Our defensive capacity lags our wealth. That gap gets people killed.

plain.li: Let them come. We're ready.

blunt.li: Now I almost want them to try something.

gloomy.li: Safer. Not safe. But safer.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a ring of iron
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build automated turrets to cover the colony's approaches.

plain.li: Turrets don't sleep, don't eat and don't panic. Let's put three on the main approaches.

blunt.li: I want guns that shoot back even when we're asleep. Turrets.

cheerful.li: Little robot guards! Okay, they're turrets. But I'm calling them guards.

gloomy.li: We can't watch every direction at once. Machines can.

cold.li: Turrets multiply our firepower at no cost in lives. Build them.

plain.li: The guns are up. The approaches are covered.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: teeth in the mud
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Line the approaches with traps so attackers bleed before they reach our walls.

plain.li: Every raider who steps on a trap is one less we have to fight. Let's lay six along the approaches.

warm.li: I'd rather they get hurt out there than we get hurt in here. Let's set some traps.

blunt.li: Spikes. Lots of spikes. Where they'll walk. Any questions?

cheerful.li: Surprise party for our next visitors! The surprise is spikes.

gloomy.li: It's ugly work. But so is burying our own.

cold.li: Traps are cheap and never miss. I find them very efficient.

plain.li: Mind where you step out there. Seriously.

cold.li: The approaches are now hostile. Good.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: keep the lights on
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build up battery storage so the colony rides out nights, calm days and eclipses.

plain.li: Every time the sun sets, the lights flicker. Let's build batteries and stop holding our breath at dusk.

blunt.li: The power keeps dying at the worst moment. Batteries. Today.

cheerful.li: Let's store up so much power we could light the whole map! Well, the colony.

gloomy.li: One eclipse and the freezer thaws. One eclipse and we starve. Batteries, please.

cold.li: Unbuffered power is a single point of failure. Storage fixes it.

plain.li: The lights stay on. Every night. Lovely.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the workshop
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build a proper workshop with at least two crafting stations.

plain.li: Clothes, tools, weapons: they all come from somewhere. Let's build a real workshop to make them.

warm.li: With a proper workshop I could keep everyone clothed and equipped. Let's build one.

blunt.li: You want gear? Then give me a workshop, not a bench in the rain.

cheerful.li: A workshop! The smell of sawdust! The sound of progress!

gloomy.li: Everything we own is falling apart. Someone has to make new things.

cold.li: Production capacity is our bottleneck. A workshop removes it.

plain.li: The workshop is open for business.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a gallery of our own
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Place three works of art in the dining room or rec room.

plain.li: Out here we survive. I want us to live, too. Three sculptures where everyone can see them.

warm.li: Art reminds us we're more than our struggles. Let's fill our common rooms with it.

blunt.li: Our walls are depressing. Let me fix that.

cheerful.li: A gallery! I already have so many ideas. One of them is a squirrel.

gloomy.li: When we're gone, the art will remain. Let's leave something behind.

cold.li: Beauty increases mood and colony value. I propose three pieces.

plain.li: Our very own gallery. Who knew we had it in us?

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the menagerie
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Tame three new animals and give them a barn to sleep in.

plain.li: The animals out there could pull carts, give milk, or just be good company. Let's tame a few and build them a barn.

warm.li: Animals make a place feel alive. Let's welcome a few into our family.

blunt.li: Free labour is walking around on four legs. Tame it.

cheerful.li: A barn full of friends! I want one of everything!

gloomy.li: Animals are honest. I could use more honesty around here.

cold.li: Tamed animals provide labour, food and defence. The return is excellent.

plain.li: Listen to them. That's the sound of a real homestead.

cheerful.li: I named all of them. Twice.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: the pursuit of knowledge
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Set up a proper laboratory and complete three research projects.

plain.li: Everything we'll ever build starts as an idea. Give me a quiet room to think in, and three projects to finish.

warm.li: Knowledge is how we'll make life better for everyone. Let's invest in it.

blunt.li: We're stumbling around in the dark. Let me do some actual research.

cheerful.li: Science! Discoveries! Probably a small explosion! Let's do it!

gloomy.li: We won't survive on what we know now. We have to learn more.

cold.li: Research compounds. Every project makes the next one more valuable.

plain.li: Three breakthroughs. And I'm only getting started.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a greenhouse
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Grow food under a roof, whatever the season, and keep the larder stocked.

plain.li: Seasons won't decide whether we eat if we grow indoors. Let's build a greenhouse.

warm.li: Fresh greens in the middle of winter. Imagine everyone's faces.

blunt.li: I'm tired of the weather deciding if we starve. Greenhouse.

cheerful.li: A whole room of growing things! It'll smell like spring all year!

gloomy.li: One bad season and we're done. Unless we grow indoors.

cold.li: Year-round production eliminates seasonal risk.

plain.li: Green and growing, whatever the weather.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a warm winter
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put a heat source in every bedroom before the cold sets in.

plain.li: Winter is coming, and frostbite isn't a hobby. Every bedroom gets a heat source.

warm.li: Nobody should shiver themselves to sleep. Let's warm every room.

blunt.li: I lost feeling in my toes last winter. Not again. Heat in every room.

cheerful.li: Cozy rooms for everyone! Winter can come and knock!

gloomy.li: The cold kills slowly. Let's not give it the chance.

cold.li: Hypothermia is preventable. Prevent it.

plain.li: Every room warm. Let it snow.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: new blood
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Welcome at least one new colonist: recruit a prisoner, take in a refugee, or answer a call for help.

plain.li: We're stretched thin. One more pair of hands would change everything.

warm.li: There are people out there with nowhere to go. Let's give one of them a home.

blunt.li: We need more people. I don't care how we get them.

cheerful.li: A new friend! I'll even give them my second-best spoon.

gloomy.li: There aren't enough of us to survive what's coming.

cold.li: Our labour shortage is critical. Recruitment is the fastest fix.

plain.li: Welcome to the colony. We're glad you're here.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: good times
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Lift the colony's average mood to 65%. Fix complaints, feed people well, let them rest.

plain.li: People are tense. Let's spend a while making this place better to live in, not just bigger.

warm.li: I see how tired everyone is. Let's take care of each other for a while.

blunt.li: Everyone's miserable and it's making me miserable. Let's fix it.

cheerful.li: Operation: Make Everyone Smile! I'm in charge of the smiling.

gloomy.li: We're one bad day from someone snapping. Let's lift the mood before that happens.

cold.li: Low morale reduces output and invites breakdowns. Raise it.

plain.li: Listen to that. People are laughing again.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a full treasury
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Build up 2000 silver for trade, ransoms and emergencies.

plain.li: When the next trader comes, I want to buy what we need, not beg. Let's save up silver.

warm.li: A good reserve of silver could save a life one day. Let's build one.

blunt.li: Money talks. Right now ours is whispering. Let's fix that.

cheerful.li: Let's get so rich the traders bow when they see us coming!

gloomy.li: Someday we'll need to buy our way out of trouble. Better have the silver.

cold.li: Liquidity provides options. I propose we accumulate some.

plain.li: A full treasury. Let the traders come.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: fine dining
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Give the cooks a real kitchen and stock twenty fine meals.

plain.li: Give me a real kitchen and good ingredients and I'll give you meals worth fighting for.

warm.li: Good food is love you can eat. Let me cook for all of you properly.

blunt.li: I'm a cook, not a miracle worker. Give me a kitchen.

cheerful.li: Fine dining on the rim! Garnish and everything!

gloomy.li: If every day is a struggle, at least dinner shouldn't be.

cold.li: Fine meals give a lasting mood bonus. The kitchen pays for itself.

plain.li: Dinner is served. Fine dining, rim style.
